required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.evidence_requirement: Ligand-supported structure, curated mechanism text, or source review must place the flavin in the oxygenating active-site chemistry rather than only in a remote electron-transfer partner.
required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.negative_signal: NADPH, NADH, heme, metal, pterin, copper, or ATP chemistry without active-site flavin oxygenation is not sufficient.

countable_values: source-equivalent reduced-flavin plus O2 oxygenating intermediate
required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.evidence_requirement: Source evidence must say or imply reduced flavin activates molecular oxygen to an oxygenating flavin-peroxy species before substrate oxygen transfer.
required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.negative_signal: Simple flavin hydride transfer, flavin reoxidation by O2 to peroxide, or water-derived oxygen does not count.

required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.evidence_requirement: Record substrate, product, and whether the inserted oxygen is O2-derived. Oxygen activation without substrate oxygen insertion is not enough.
required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.negative_signal: Substrate oxidation that produces reduced flavin, electron relay, or peroxide without oxygen insertion stays outside FMO.

required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.evidence_requirement: Document how the flavin becomes reduced. For two-component systems, distinguish the reductase partner from the oxygenating monooxygenase component.
required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.negative_signal: A reductase-only subunit, generic NADPH binding, or flavin reduction without substrate oxygenation is not countable FMO evidence.

required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.evidence_requirement: Record residue identifiers and roles when known; do not use motif presence alone as a counting rule because FMO subclasses are not residue-identical.
known_current_examples: m_csa:973 source context reports His92, Tyr96, Asn129, Ser163, and a residue-391 role; resolve His391/Cys391 discrepancy before counting active-site evidence.
m_csa:551 source context reports FAD motion coupled to conformational movement; record the structural state and residue range rather than treating it as a conserved motif.

required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.evidence_requirement: Record whether the selected structure actually captures the oxygenating active site. Transient C4a-peroxy states may be source-supported even when not crystallized, but apo or remote-partner-only structures remain review-only.
required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.negative_signal: Geometry from apo structures, missing flavin, missing substrate pocket, unresolved catalytic residues, or an isolated reductase partner cannot be used as clean countable support.

required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.evidence_requirement: Future metric rows must separate evidence used for curation from features allowed in prediction or scoring, and must pass duplicate/leakage review before benchmark use.
required_evidence_fields_for_future_coun.negative_signal: Rows accepted only because the name contains monooxygenase, hydroxylase, FMO, or an EC class are not countable.

separation_and_exclusion_rules.rule: Exclude hydride-transfer flavoproteins where substrate oxidation reduces FAD/FMN and O2 is only a terminal electron acceptor or produces peroxide, unless source evidence shows flavin-peroxy substrate oxygen insertion.
Exclude FAD/FMN plus Fe-S systems that relay electrons to another acceptor, metal center, heme, or radical chemistry without an oxygenating C4a-peroxyflavin active site.
Exclude radical dehydratases, radical SAM-like boundaries, covalent flavin adduct chemistry, or O2-independent radical rearrangements even when flavin is required.
Exclude heme-centered oxygen activation and heme oxygen insertion even if the reaction is a monooxygenation.
Exclude tetrahydrobiopterin, non-heme iron, copper, diiron methane monooxygenase, and other metal-only oxygenases without flavin C4a-peroxy chemistry.
Exclude oxygenation driven through ATP/luciferyl-adenylate or other non-flavin activation unless explicit flavin C4a-peroxy substrate oxygenation is present.
Exclude rows whose only support is entry name, EC class, or broad oxygenase annotation. Countable FMO support must satisfy the evidence fields above.

minimum_support_before_primary_promotion.diversity_preference: Prefer at least three mechanistic or substrate subclasses, such as aromatic hydroxylation, Baeyer-Villiger oxygen insertion, N/S oxygenation, and two-component FMNH2 systems.
hard_negative_control_classes: radical flavin or flavin Fe-S enzyme
minimum_support_before_primary_promotion.primary_reconsideration_rule: Do not reconsider primary promotion until clean positives reach n>=6 and the hard-negative control packet is explicitly reviewed.

benchmark_use_policy.future_primary_path: Future primary reconsideration only after n>=6 clean rows, hard-negative separation, duplicate/leakage review, and expert sign-off.
